skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic concepts and theories of capital markets, including the structure, functions, and operations of capital markets.
Analyze and evaluate investment opportunities in capital markets, including the valuation of financial assets and the performance of investment funds.
Identify and solve problems related to capital markets, including the issuance of securities and investment activities.
Develop research skills to analyze issues related to capital markets, including the ability to work independently and in groups.
Demonstrate the ability to learn independently, organize personal study, and complete assigned tasks.
Work collaboratively in groups to solve problems and complete tasks related to capital markets.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve problems in capital markets.
Communicate effectively in class discussions and presentations related to capital markets.
Demonstrate ethical responsibility and discipline in class participation and group work.
